description: Return the same recent attribution events and installs visible on the Live dashboard.

app_id.description: Optional app id to scope the result to one app.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to fetch the following page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: First UTC day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. May be sent without to. Sending from, to or cursor switches the response to paged mode, which adds next_cursor.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1-50. The API returns 50 when omitted.

to.description: Last UTC day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. May be sent without from.

name: list_recent_events
title: List recent events and installs
